form.official-title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 189 East Main Street in Xenia, Ohio, as the Gil Whitney Post Office Building.

subsection.text: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 189 East Main Street in Xenia, Ohio, shall be known and designated as the Gil Whitney Post Office Building.

Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the facility referred to in subsection (a) shall be deemed to be a reference to the Gil Whitney Post Office Building.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 16, 2026.
